$comment: THE statement of what a provenance.json must carry. Read by the Rust gate (every_scenario_declares_its_provenance), the Python gate (fixture-age.py --check-metadata) and the README table, each of which used to state it separately — two of the three had already drifted, and the weaker one owned the wider population.

recorded.means: real wire bytes; the recorder writes this file itself

composed.means: hand-written, and the note says how you can tell

unknown.means: predates the rule; nobody recorded where it came from
